title: Transport of actual levels and their descended transitions
statement: Let X,Y be schemes, g:Y→X, d an adic coefficient datum on A, U in Y.ProEt, V in U.left.ProEt, W in Y.ProEt, and f:W→ProEt.mk(V.hom≫U.hom). Write L_n for fixed-B_n inverse image along f.left followed by lisseTowerFixedRealization(W.hom≫g,d,n), where B_n=lisseTowerEtaleRing(d,n). Let M be an adic tower on X and D_n etale B_n-complexes on U.left [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower, def-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-etale-descent-data]. Supply section-normalized ordinary squares c_n, arrows delta_n:D_(n+1)→Res(q_n)D_n, level comparisons e_n to adicTowerPullback(U.hom≫g)(M_n), and their descent equations [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-scalar-restriction]. There exist actual_n:L_n(localProEtaleComparison(V.hom,B_n)(D_n))≅adicTowerPullback(W.hom≫g)(M_n). With H_n=pbcDerivedRestrict(constantAdicFiniteProjection(W.hom≫g,d,n)), H_(n+1)L_(n+1)(localProEtaleNormalization(delta_n)) followed by the scalar of [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-tower-pulled-scalar] and H_n(actual_n) equals H_(n+1)(actual_(n+1)) followed by constantAdicRestrictedStep(W.hom≫g,d,M,n). No constant-model comparison or algebraic-arrow assertion is included.

proof.text: let a = f.left followed by V.hom, from W.left to U.left. On ordinary module sheaves, associated-module-sheafification and inverse image have canonically isomorphic composites: the map is induced by identity on pulled presheaf sections, and its inverse is determined by the same sheafification adjunction. Apply this to the locally bijective finite scalar presentations lisseTowerFiniteScalarMap. The resulting comparison identifies fixed realization after inverse image along a with module inverse image after fixed realization on U.left. Localize this exact comparison and paste the inverse-image compositors for f.left, V.hom and U.hom followed by g. The equation f.w gives a followed by U.hom = W.hom, so applying this comparison, inverse image of the specified e_n, and the actual module inverse-image compositor gives actual_n. This construction works for every n without boundedness assumptions.

For consecutive levels, the ordinary coefficient-interchange cube commutes: after forgetting to abelian sheaves all of its maps are induced by the same identity on pulled sections. The supplied hc_n and lisseTowerNormalizedScalarSquare_sections at W fix the two ordinary scalar faces, so faithfulness of forgetting modules proves the cube before localization. Localize it, retaining mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and the two restriction compositors rather than replacing them by arbitrary isomorphisms. Apply inverse image to hdelta_n. Naturality of the level comparisons moves e_n and e_(n+1) through the cube. Composition coherence for inverse image identifies the transported actual transition with adicTowerRestrictedTransition at W.hom followed by g. Its further restriction to completion coefficients is exactly constantAdicRestrictedStep, by that definition and constantAdicFiniteProjection_comp. Cancelling the common invertible comparison factors gives the displayed equation. The construction uses no constant algebraic models and no choices of local markings, and works on zero objects and empty bases.

theorem lisseTower_localized_actual
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (U : Y.ProEt) (V : U.left.ProEt) (W : Y.ProEt)
    (f : W ⟶ ProEt.mk (V.hom ≫ U.hom))
    (D : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))))
    (c : ∀ n : ℕ, LisseTowerScalarSquare (U.hom ≫ g) d n)
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, LisseTowerScalarSquareSections (U.hom ≫ g) d n (c n))
    (δ : ∀ n : ℕ, D (n + 1) ⟶
      (normalizationRestrict U.left.smallEtaleTopology (lisseTowerEtaleQuotient d n)).obj
        (D n))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, (lisseTowerEtaleRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d n).obj (D n) ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))
    (hδ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (lisseTowerEtaleRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d (n + 1)).map (δ n) ≫
          (lisseTowerEtaleScalarIso (U.hom ≫ g) d n (c n)).hom.app (D n) ≫
          (pbcDerivedRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map
            (pbcAdicQuotient X d (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)))).map (e n).hom =
        (e (n + 1)).hom ≫
          adicTowerRestrictedTransition d (U.hom ≫ g) M (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)) :
    let L (j : ℕ) := (ProEtale.upperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d j)) f.left).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        lisseTowerFixedRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d j
    ∃ actual : ∀ (n : ℕ),
    (L n).obj
      ((localProEtaleComparison V.hom (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)).obj (D n)) ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n),
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
    let H (k : ℕ) := pbcDerivedRestrict (constantAdicFiniteProjection (W.hom ≫ g) d k)
    (H (n + 1)).map ((L (n + 1)).map
      (localProEtaleNormalization V.hom (lisseTowerEtaleQuotient d n) (δ n))) ≫
      (lisseTowerPulledScalarIso (W.hom ≫ g) f.left d n).hom.app
        ((localProEtaleComparison V.hom (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)).obj (D n)) ≫
      (H n).map (actual n).hom =
    (H (n + 1)).map (actual (n + 1)).hom ≫
      constantAdicRestrictedStep (W.hom ≫ g) d M n
